page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance situated within the gn5 instance family. Powered by KVM virtualization and an x86_64 processor architecture, the instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs paired with 240.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 7.5 GB of RAM per vCPU.

Hardware acceleration is supplied by four NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPUs, offering an aggregate total of 64 GB of GPU memory across the four discrete accelerator units. Local host storage is bundled with the instance in the form of an 1889 GB SSD, facilitating low-latency access to local temporary datasets and scratch spaces without relying solely on remote volumes. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

While the Pascal-generation NVIDIA P100 hardware represents an older architectural class lacking modern tensor-core acceleration features, the multi-GPU topology paired with substantial system RAM and dedicated local solid-state storage provides significant parallel compute density. This makes the ecs.gn5-c8g1.8xlarge appropriate for distributed GPU computing, legacy machine learning model training, rendering, physical simulations, and data-intensive batch workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.8xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated virtual server powered by KVM on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs and 240.0 GB of memory, paired with four NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPUs totaling 64 GB of VRAM. The instance includes 1889 GB of integrated local SSD storage for fast data access, alongside a 10 Gbps baseline networking interface. By combining four discrete accelerators with high-density host memory and onboard solid-state storage, this configuration delivers substantial parallel computing throughput. It is engineered for distributed machine learning training, scientific research simulations, high-performance data transformations, and computer vision workloads that utilize legacy CUDA architectures.
